design_system.philosophy: Dark-first design. Clarity over decoration. Teenage Engineering's tactile utility meets Linear's pure functionality. True black backgrounds, thin SVG lines, bento box grids, and sage green active states.

styles.body_secondary: font-size: 14px, font-weight: 400, letter-spacing: 0em, line-height: 1.5, color: text_secondary
styles.mono_label: font-size: 12px, font-family: mono_family, font-weight: 500, letter-spacing: 0.05em, text-transform: uppercase

buttons.primary: background: primary_accent, color: background_base, border-radius: 4px, padding: 16px 24px, font-weight: 600, justify-content: center
buttons.secondary: background: transparent, border: thin, color: text_primary, border-radius: 4px, padding: 16px 24px
buttons.ghost: background: transparent, color: text_secondary, hover-color: text_primary

cards.base: background: background_surface, border: thin, border-radius: 8px, padding: 16px
cards.interactive: hover-border: border_active, transform: scale(0.98) on press

sudoku_grid.container: aspect-ratio: 1/1, display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr), gap: 8px, background: background_base, padding: 8px, border: thin, border-radius: 8px
sudoku_grid.slot: background: background_surface, border: 1px dashed border_subtle, border-radius: 4px, align-items: center, justify-content: center

tags.base: background: background_elevated, border: thin, border-radius: 9999px, padding: 4px 12px, font-size: 12px

elements: Hero Illustration: 3x3 Grid wireframe (Teenage Engineering style)
H1: '9 Items. 27 Outfits.'
Body: 'The Sudoku packing method generates maximum combinations with minimal garments.'
Primary CTA: 'Get Started' (data-testid='onboarding-start-button')
Input: Destination (large typography, transparent background, bottom border only) (data-testid='trip-dest-input')
Date Picker: Minimalist text-based calendar picker
Primary CTA: 'Create Trip'
Header: 'Upcoming Trips' + Add Button
Bento Cards (Horizontal Scroll): Destination, Countdown, Weather Open-Meteo summary
Stats Module: Mono-font numbers (Efficiency Ratio 3.0, 27/27 combos)
Progress Bar: Packing progress
Camera FAB: Floating action button for photo capture
Garment Cards: Image with dark overlay, Category Tag (Top/Bottom/Layer)
Color Palette: Small circular swatches extracted from garment

5_sudoku_grid.layout: Central focused UI, non-scrollable area for drag-drop
elements: Top Header: 'Build Your Grid'
3x3 Interactive Canvas: 9 slots with haptic snap zones
Bottom Drawer: Horizontally scrolling wardrobe items categorized (Tops, Bottoms, Layers)
Conflict Checker Banner: Appears if rule violated (e.g. 'Row 2 repeats Top')
Primary CTA: 'Generate Lookbook' (data-testid='generate-lookbook-button')

6_lookbook.layout: Vertical feed (TikTok/Instagram style scrolling or 1-column list)
elements: Outfit Card: Composite of 3 items (Top, Bottom, Layer) stacked vertically or elegantly arranged
Actions: Heart/Favorite icon, Occasion Tag picker
Filter Bar: 'All', 'Favorites', '#Travel', '#Formal'
Section Header: 'The Grid (9/9)'
Section Header: 'Essentials' (Toiletries, Chargers)
Checklist Items: Custom checkbox (square, thin border, filled with sage green on check) (data-testid='checklist-item')
Weight Total: Sticky footer showing total kg vs carry-on limit

micro_interactions.grid_snap: Haptic feedback (ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light) when a garment snaps into a 3x3 slot.
micro_interactions.conflict_warning: Slight horizontal shake animation on the grid slot and a color shift to conflict_warning orange.
micro_interactions.progress_fill: Smooth width transition with an ease-out spring animation for the progress bar.
micro_interactions.checkbox_toggle: Scale down to 0.9 then bounce to 1.0 with a subtle green flash on check.
micro_interactions.screen_transitions: Fade and slight upward translation (slide-up 10px) to mimic physical layer stacking.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the pure black (#000000) background for the Dark default theme.
Ensure all fonts use 'Inter' for UI and a Monospace font for data/statistics.
Use standard React Native Views with custom borders (1px) for the 'Linear Look'.
Avoid using native <Button> or standard iOS/Android form controls. Build custom Pressables to maintain the Teenage Engineering technical aesthetic.
The 3x3 Grid must enforce the Sudoku rule: no category can repeat in any row, column, or diagonal. Visually highlight conflicts using the conflict_warning color.
Implement test IDs (`data-testid`) for all touchable/interactive elements.
Use React Native Reanimated for the micro-interactions, particularly the haptic grid snap and progress fills.
Rely on the provided media URLs for any empty states or onboarding visuals. Never use via.placeholder.com or similar generic services.
Navigation should favor minimalist bottom tabs or structural top headers rather than hamburger menus, maintaining the 'content-first' app architecture.
